title: Skill definitions
description: The player's active-attack skills (G2): each replaces the basic attack when chosen at the start of a new game. Loaded identically by the Godot client; the Go server does not read this file today. See docs/0016.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this file's shape.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier; never reused or renamed (persisted in save files).

element.description: Feeds the existing damage-type/resistance model (docs/0016): 'cold' is the renamed home for the seed list's 'ice' skills, and every skill is typed (no 'none' channel).

kind.description: melee swings like the base attack; ranged fires a projectile from range.

range.description: Metres, between body origins. Melee ~1.5-2.5, ranged ~6-14.

actions_per_second.description: Attacks per second for a melee skill, casts per second for a ranged one — see PlayerStats/docs/0016 for how this feeds attack_speed vs cast_speed.
